set.body: Add a typed threshold contract distinct from display windowing, matching the documented neuroimjs behavior: a valid open band can become transparent while values outside remain colorized, with an explicit disabled state. Thread it through colorizers, layer presentation, viewer actions, cache identity and profiles. Add boundary, NaN, overlay, cache-recolor, JVM and Scala.js tests.
set.title: Viewer pipeline 2: first-class threshold semantics matching neuroimjs
